messages.content: Now that the Providence flights are set, compare the downtown Hampton with the airport hotel for Wednesday and Thursday nights. I need the full totals, not just nightly rates.

For June 16-18, the Hampton Inn & Suites Providence Downtown has a queen room at $249 per night. Two nights are $498, and the 13% combined lodging and sales tax is $64.74, for a complete total of $562.74. The Fairfield Inn & Suites Providence Airport Warwick has a king room at $179 per night: $358 plus $46.54 tax, totaling $404.54. Both include Wi-Fi and breakfast; the Fairfield also has a complimentary airport shuttle.
So the Fairfield saves $158.20. What are the cancellation cutoffs for each?

Correct, the difference is $158.20. The Hampton can be canceled without charge until 11:59 p.m. Eastern on Monday, June 14; after that, the penalty is one night plus tax, or $281.37. The Fairfield remains refundable until 6:00 p.m. Eastern on Tuesday, June 15; its late-cancellation penalty is $202.27.

Check the actual work routes. Thursday's lender meeting is on Benefit Street at 9:00, and Friday's installation is at the gallery on Empire Street. I also need to get back to the hotel for my suitcase before the 7:20 flight.

From the Hampton, the Benefit Street lender office is about a 12-minute walk, and the Empire Street gallery is roughly 0.7 mile away, usually 5-10 minutes by car. From the Fairfield, plan on about 18-25 minutes to Benefit Street Thursday morning and 20-30 minutes to Empire Street Friday, with more variability during commuter traffic.
And the Friday sequence from each hotel if I leave the gallery at 4:30?

With the Hampton, allow 5-10 minutes from the gallery to the hotel, about 10 minutes to collect the stored suitcase, and 15-25 minutes from downtown to PVD. That puts you at the airport around 5:15-5:25 p.m. With the Fairfield, the gallery-to-hotel leg is about 20-30 minutes, suitcase pickup about 10 minutes, then roughly 5 minutes to the terminal by hotel shuttle or rideshare. Arrival would be around 5:15-5:30, but the shuttle schedule could add a wait.
Does the Hampton confirm they'll hold the bag after Friday checkout, or is that only an assumption?

It is confirmed for this rate: the front desk will store one suitcase after the 11:00 a.m. Friday checkout at no charge, with same-day collection. They recommend allowing 10 minutes to retrieve it. The Fairfield offers the same service, but its airport shuttle runs every 30 minutes, so a rideshare would be safer if timing slips.
The downtown one sounds less complicated even though it costs more. Is there any issue getting there after the Pawtucket dock Wednesday afternoon?

No material issue. From the Pawtucket receiving dock, the Hampton is approximately 6 miles away and normally a 15-25 minute ride after your 3:30 p.m. obligation. Check-in starts at 4:00 p.m., so the room should be available by the time you arrive.
Before booking, give me the full Hampton arrangement in one place.

Hampton Inn & Suites Providence Downtown, one queen room for one adult, check-in Wednesday, June 16, and checkout Friday, June 18. The total is $562.74: $498 room charge plus $64.74 tax. Breakfast and Wi-Fi are included. Friday checkout is at 11:00 a.m., and one suitcase may be stored free until you return that afternoon. Free cancellation ends at 11:59 p.m. Eastern on June 14; the later penalty is $281.37. It is about a 12-minute walk to Thursday's Benefit Street appointment and a short ride from Friday's Empire Street gallery.
Book that Hampton room with the card ending in 1842.

The Hampton room is reserved for June 16-18 on the card ending in 1842. Confirmation number is PVD62841, and the confirmed total is $562.74, payable at the hotel. Cancellation remains free through 11:59 p.m. Eastern on June 14. Friday luggage storage is noted on the reservation. Your Delta flights under H7Q4LM were not changed.
